Name: FS - SubtlyLiminal's Hairstyles
Author: SubtlyLiminal
Description:
[b]NOTICE FOR USERS UPGRADING TO 3.0.0 FROM A PREVIOUS VERSION:  I completely renamed each hair for organization purposes (Fashion Sense displays numbered lists over 9 weird), so you may encounter errors if you had a hairstyle from this mod equipped.  I haven't tested it myself, but to be safe, I recommend unequipping your Fashion Sense hairstyle before you update.  [/b]LMK if this is a problem or not!

We've got pixie cuts!  Chelsea cuts!  Pigtails!  Ponytails!  Buns!  Receding hairlines!

I didn't make hat chops.  If these end up looking too weird with hats, I might in the future, but I wanted to start simple for now because this is my first mod ever.

I want to thank malic18 ﻿for[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8821] Non Replacing Hair Resource[/url], and the people in [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/tutorial-tips-on-converting-hairstyles-to-be-non-replacing-additions-using-content-patcher.8648/]these[/url] [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/help-modding-hair-2-questions.131175/]threads[/url].  They gave me great tools and references so I could know what I was doing.  And of course, thank you to PeacefulEnd for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] and the example pack!
